commands: set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --prune origin main ui/radar-details-redesign; test "$(git rev-parse origin/ui/radar-details-redesign)" = 'f9b0e00977016bcd7fec92a18754ef144c686d44'; echo '=== DOC FILES ==='; find docs -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' -print | sort
set -euo pipefail; echo '=== FIRST HEADINGS ==='; for f in docs/*.md; do printf '%s: ' "$f"; sed -n '1p' "$f"; done | sort
set -euo pipefail; echo '=== STATUS MARKERS ==='; grep -HnEi 'status|superseded|canonical|closed|blocked|unblocked' docs/*.md | head -n 500 || true; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
